data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.question: apprenticeship
sections.summary: A period of working under an experienced person to learn a trade or skill.

senses.definition: a period of time spent working for an employer while learning the practical skills needed for a particular trade or profession
examples: She started an apprenticeship with a local electrician.

answers.answer: She started an apprenticeship with a local electrician.
She apprenticed her university degree.
An apprenticeship is a school certificate.

sections.question: assignment
sections.summary: A piece of work given to a student or employee as part of their duties.

senses.definition: a piece of work or a task that is given to someone, especially a student, as part of their studies or job
examples: I handed in my assignment before the deadline.

answers.answer: I handed in my assignment before the deadline.
I assigned my homework to the teacher.
An assignment is a type of lecture.

sections.question: boss
sections.summary: The person who is in charge of a workplace or group of workers.

senses.definition: the person who is in charge of an organization, business, or group of workers, and who gives orders or makes decisions
examples: My boss approved my holiday request.

answers.answer: My boss approved my holiday request.
My bossed me yesterday at work.
A boss is a university degree.

sections.question: career
sections.summary: The series of jobs or profession that a person has over their working life.

senses.definition: the work and professional activities that someone does over their working life, often in one particular area
examples: She is planning a career in engineering.

answers.answer: She is planning a career in engineering.
She careered her homework last night.
A career is a school project.

sections.question: certificate
sections.summary: An official document proving that you have completed a course or achieved a qualification.

senses.definition: an official document that proves you have successfully completed a course of study, passed an exam, or achieved a particular level
examples: He received a certificate after finishing the training.

answers.answer: He received a certificate after finishing the training.
He certificated the seminar yesterday.
A certificate is a type of homework.

sections.question: class
sections.summary: A group of students taught together, or the lesson they attend.

senses.definition: a group of students who are taught together, or the period of time during which they are taught
examples: Our English class starts at 9 a.m.

answers.answer: Our English class starts at 9 a.m.
I classed my teacher yesterday.
A class is a job position.

sections.question: conference
sections.summary: A large formal meeting where people discuss a particular topic, often over several days.

senses.definition: a large formal meeting, often lasting several days, where people with shared interests or the same profession come together to discuss topics
examples: She presented her research at an international conference.

answers.answer: She presented her research at an international conference.
She conferenced her homework.
A conference is a school exam.

sections.question: course
sections.summary: A series of lessons or study on a particular subject, often leading to a qualification.

senses.definition: a series of lessons or study on a particular subject, often designed to teach a skill or lead to a qualification
examples: He enrolled in a course on digital marketing.

answers.answer: He enrolled in a course on digital marketing.
He coursed his professor yesterday.
A course is a company manager.

sections.question: degree
sections.summary: A qualification awarded by a university after completing a programme of study.

senses.definition: an academic qualification awarded by a university or college when a student has successfully completed a course of study
examples: She earned a degree in biology.

answers.answer: She earned a degree in biology.
She degreed from university.
A degree is a classroom teacher.

sections.question: diploma
sections.summary: An official document awarded by an educational institution for completing a course or programme.

senses.definition: an official document given by an educational institution to show that a student has successfully completed a course or programme of study
examples: He received a diploma after completing the program.

answers.answer: He received a diploma after completing the program.
He diplomad his exam results.
A diploma is a homework task.
